sentences.text: S1 (Priya Nair) identified as the Care Assessor from the adult social care team.
S2 (Dennis Walsh) and S3 (Karen Walsh, his daughter) were present at the meeting.
The meeting was a six-month review of the care package.
S1 informed S2 that she would be writing notes and that disclosures of risk could be shared with the council if harm was suspected, with S2 agreeing to this.
S2 confirmed he currently has Brightpath Home Care visiting four times a day: morning, dinner, tea, and bed.
S2 stated that Shelley, the carer for teatime, is lovely and takes her time.
S2 disclosed he cannot do buttons any more due to his hands.
S2 disclosed he does not go up the stairs and sleeps downstairs.
S3 stated the bed was brought down in March after a fall.
S2 stated he uses the frame around the house most of the time, but only when he remembers.
S3 stated carers do microwave meals at dinner and tea, and she brings a proper dinner round on a Sunday.
S2 stated carers prompt his diabetes tablets, which he takes in the morning and night.
S2 identified Lee as a carer who does the mornings, most mornings.
S2 disclosed that Lee slapped him across the face last Thursday because he was slow getting off the bed.
S2 disclosed that Lee had also slapped him once before, a few weeks back, for being too slow.
S2 confirmed the slapping was done with an open hand on the face.
S2 disclosed that Lee grabbed his arm to pull him up off the commode.
S2 stated Lee grabbed his arm hard on Saturday, which really hurt him.
S2 identified the left arm as the one that was grabbed hard.
S3 disclosed she found out about the abuse when she helped him change his top on Sunday and saw bruises on his upper left arm.
S3 described the bruises as four in a row, like fingermarks, on the inside of his upper arm, and stated they were purple.
S3 stated she took photos of the bruises on her phone on Sunday.
S3 stated that when she asked her dad about the bruises, he initially said he'd knocked it, but last night he told her about Lee.
S2 disclosed he did not want a fuss and did not want to lose the carers.
S1 confirmed S2 would not lose his care because he disclosed the abuse.
S2 denied that anyone else in the family or anyone else had ever hurt him.
S2 disclosed he had not told anyone at Brightpath about the abuse because he did not know who to tell.
S2 stated he did not want Lee coming any more and wanted someone like Shelley.
S3 stated that S2 gets the higher rate of Attendance Allowance.
S3 stated she does his shopping with his card and keeps the receipts.
S2 disclosed he used to go to the bowls club but has not been since his hip.
S1 suggested a Wednesday lunch club at the community centre on Mill Lane with transport.
S2 agreed to find out about the lunch club.
S1 agreed to raise a safeguarding concern with the council's safeguarding team regarding Lee slapping S2 and grabbing his arm.
S2 agreed to the safeguarding concern being raised.
S1 agreed to ring the manager at Brightpath this afternoon to ask that Lee does not come to S2 again while it is looked into.
S1 instructed S3 to keep the photos of the bruises and not delete them, as the safeguarding team may ask for them.
S3 agreed to keep the photos.
S1 instructed S3 to book a GP appointment for S2's arm by Friday.
S3 agreed to ring the surgery tomorrow to book the appointment.
S1 stated the police might want to speak to S2.
S2 stated he would be okay with the police speaking to him if it stops Lee from doing it to someone else.
S1 agreed to send lunch club details by the end of next week.
S1 agreed to phone S2 on Monday the 30th to let him know what is happening.
